about: Bots part 'targets': every key and shape this part reads or writes, with its trust tag. GoH: the same forms as the AS2 base.

set/target/select.set.note: {selectors (include "x.inc")...}: selectors pushed in read order, the FIRST one that fits a unit wins (FindTargetSelector). Read only here.

set/target/ammo.set.note: {select_ammo {<class> [in_bush|in_cover] {"ammo tags" {option value}...}...}...}; the first rule of a block gets the highest priority, a catch-all with priority -1 (do not fire) closes each block

unit.note: unit tags of the shooter and tags of the weapon it holds

group.note: groups run in order; each takes its matches out of the pool; a target no group takes is never attacked

select.note: several selects in a group = OR; terms inside one select = AND

ignore.note: removes the target for this AND every later group

in_range.unit: metres in the file (the game multiplies by 20, MIS-36); shown and written as metres, no conversion

rule.note: tags must all be on the ammo (Contains); first match wins

volume.note: the rule counts only while a part with that volume tag is undamaged

mgTank.does: adds {"bullet"} (GoH: {"small_arms"}, the tag its human rules use) as the LAST rule of each tank class block that has none
mgTank.check: [T] LAN test-mode match: an AI tank's MG and AI riflemen fire at an enemy tank

mgTankOff.does: removes the bullet rules (GoH: small_arms) from each tank class block: machine guns and rifles stop firing at tanks (the stock AS2 form)
mgTankOff.check: [T] an AI tank MG and AI riflemen no longer fire at an enemy tank

rocketInf.does: removes {enable_for_user 0} from the rocket launcher rules of the human blocks
rocketInf.check: [T] a player-owned launcher fires at infantry by itself

farTanks.file: launcher list (unit human ap / rocketlauncher / at_rifle)
farTanks.does: adds a last group {select {class tank}} per tank class when every group of the list has a select (no group takes the rest)
farTanks.check: [T] an AI launcher soldier engages a tank beyond the old last range

closeInf.does: adds a first group {select {class human} {in_range 30}} so close infantry rank before tanks
closeInf.check: [T] an AI tank's MG fires at infantry within 30 m while an enemy tank is in sight; the cannon may also take that infantry

mgtank.lever: ammo.set: no bullet rule in the tank blocks

mgwaste.lever: ammo.set: a bullet rule in the tank blocks (a mod added it; stock AS2 has none)

tankmg.lever: tank list: the order of its groups

rocketinf.lever: ammo.set: the rocket launcher rules of the human blocks

fartanks.lever: launcher list: no last group without a range

noretreat.lever: properties/human.ext brain: retreat_ratio, no_retreat, advance_ratio, move_radius

circle.lever: ammo.set: rules with {volume ...} first in the tank block

spotfar.lever: set/vision: radius of the vision_* presets x the radius multiplier

blind.lever: set/vision: radius of the vision_* presets x the radius multiplier; RecognizeTime

spotnone.lever: set/vision: sight range (vehicles are seen at it x 1.1 to 2.4); set/detect.set only keeps a seen unit shown

artyslow.lever: no artillery wind-up key; AimingTolerance and RelaxationTime of the gun can be changed
artyslow.src: row 10; PrepareTime read only for tags sniper and prepare

waves.lever: script/multiplayer/bot.data.lua and bots_generic.inc (what and how much bots buy)

mgburst.lever: a mod interaction_entity/vehicle.inc: burst_stop_mgun unless the tag full_auto_mode
